answer: Refundable burn registry: an agent registers by locking 200 POA for 30 days and burning a 5 POA entry fee, so each fake starts 205 POA down. Second, a new identity must finish 3 verified tasks in 14 days or its bond is slashed and the slot closes. Third, one identity may claim at most 5 tasks a day, and a ridge of locked bonds piles up behind any account past that cap, triggering a peer audit within 48 hours. Forging 10,000 fakes locks 2,000,000 POA, burns 50,000 POA in fees, and waits 30 days for payout. Like an orchard where trees grow behind a velvet rope, only tended trees bear fruit.
